name: Limited photo access (chosen items only)
plain: The person shares only hand-picked photos with the app, not the whole library.
meaning: Lets someone give an app a few images without exposing everything. The app sees only chosen assets and cannot tell what else exists.

android.prompt_ui: Select photos and videos (limited), Allow all, Don't allow
android.persistence: Selection kept until revoked; app may be asked to refresh
android.revocation: Settings > Apps > Permissions > Photos and videos
android.store_policy: Play: apps must handle partial grants without breaking
android.api_surface: MediaStore queries return only selected items
android.note: Apps targeting 33 or lower get the selection treated as the full media grant for the picked items

ios.prompt_ui: Select Photos, Allow Access to All Photos, Don't Allow
ios.persistence: Selection persists until the person edits it
ios.revocation: Settings > Privacy & Security > Photos > Edit Selected Photos
ios.store_policy: App Review 5.1.1: apps must work with a limited library
ios.note: System auto adds assets the app creates with PHAssetCreationRequest to the selection; user albums cannot be fetched or created

limits.headline: Can see only the photos you hand pick, not your whole library
limits.user_action: You tap Select Photos and choose a few in the prompt
can: Open the photos and videos you chose
Show a button to let you add more photos later on iPhone
Save and keep photos it makes itself; iPhone adds these to your shared picks
Use your picks for uploads and editing
cannot: See the rest of your library
Fetch or create your own albums on iPhone while access is limited
Keep an old pick if you remove it
limits.differs: iPhone has had Limited access since iOS 14. Android 14 and newer works similarly; apps aimed at Android 13 or lower treat picks as a normal grant.

story.what_it_is: Lets you share only hand picked photos with an app.

marketing.name: Limited Photos Library
marketing.pitch: Pitch: choose exactly which photos an app can see, and change that choice any time.

story.for_you: The pop up lets you choose Select photos. The app sees only the ones you pick, and cannot tell how many others exist. iPhone later reminds you of your picks.
story.for_makers: Makers get what they need for a task without fear. The app must handle a small set of photos, and it cannot nag users into full access.

use_cases.example: A social app shows only the five photos you picked.
A photo editor opens just your chosen pictures.
A visual search app searches with a photo you picked.
A dating app sees only the photos you want on your profile.
A game uses a few photos as puzzle images.
A vault app protects a handful of private photos.
A chat app sends only the photos you allowed.

risks: Apps may keep asking for more
Easy to forget what you shared
story.android_note: Android 14 offers a similar choice with partial access.
story.ios_note: Built in as Limited access in the Photos permission since iOS 14.

technical_bounds: Cannot fetch or create user albums in limited mode on iOS
Existing apps are affected without a code change

abuse: Pressuring users to switch to full access with repeated nags

history.change: Limited library introduced; automatic prompt to revise selection once per app launch
presentLimitedLibraryPicker gains completion handler returning new identifiers
Partial photo and video access added

Android 14: Partial access to photos and videos
